title: Missing moneylending collector found dead in Lanao del Sur

blocks.text: PARANG, Maguindanao del Norte — Police found the body of a missing moneylending collector buried in a shallow grave in a pineapple plantation in Wao, Lanao del Sur, on Friday afternoon, police said.
